name: Marsh Screw Amphibian
evidence: geometry direct (report p. 4-5: drum 26 in, over helix 31 in, rotor length in ground contact 129.5 in of 152 in overall, lead 48 in, rotor spacing 66 in); masses direct from p. 4 (2860 lb empty, 3954 lb loaded, converted); power direct (116 bhp at 3600 rpm); speed is the 1.6 mph average on sand p. 18; mu_drawbar is the sand towing figure p. 21; helix angle calculated at the mean diameter; n_starts ASSUMED single start
notes: Loaded minus empty (1094 lb) taken as payload. Earlier row carried 2335 lb dry and 3735 lb gross from the working spreadsheet and mu_drawbar 0.64, none of which are in the report; replaced September 2026. Fine-grained soil with free water (RCI 20-30): 425 lb maximum towing force at about 28 percent slip, 0.107 of test weight. Loaded vehicle climbed 18 deg sand slope, failed 21 deg. Ground pressure at 3 in penetration 0.52 psi empty and 0.72 psi loaded. First-pass rut on sand CI 60 unloaded 5.6 in. VCI 5 on fine-grained soil against 25 for the M29C Weasel. villacres2023 separately reports 54 percent drawbar for the 1/5 scale model in snow.
